title: Ukrainian Mushroom Dumplings
description: Pillowy dumplings filled with a bitter mushroom and mirepoix mixture, wrapped in lotus leaves and served as a comforting dish, these dumplings are perfect for a sick day, featuring a blend of pepper and Jain-friendly ingredients.
instructions: Finely chop the onion, carrots, and celery to create a mirepoix mixture.
Saute the mirepoix mixture in vegetable oil until the vegetables are tender.
Add the mushrooms to the mirepoix mixture and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown.
Season the mushroom mixture with salt and black pepper.
Prepare the lotus leaves by washing and trimming them to size.
Place a tablespoon of the mushroom mixture in the center of each lotus leaf.
Fold the lotus leaves to form a triangle or square shape, and press the edges together to seal the dumpling.
Steam the dumplings over boiling water for 10-12 minutes, or until they are cooked through.
Serve the dumplings hot, garnished with additional black pepper if desired.
